{JOBY/MARK: This is really more for Mark (though Joby can pre-structure the conversation to better accommodate it), but I'd rather see it as the player choosing to say the right things, rather than answering riddles. (Plus I don't know if Inifere is coherent enough to ask questions - he's kind of insane).

So something like:
[Inifere is wary, but is listening.]
PR: I know you don't want the cultists to kill people.
[Inifere listens more.]
PR: Marcysa... you loved her didn't you.
[Inifere nods, not trusting himself to say words.]
PR: I can help you. I can change what happened to Marcysa. Just let me into your Merecaster.
[Inifere reluctantly agrees.]

Of course these would require other non-winning options as well (or alternative winning options might be okay too - whatever seems most fun for the player). -AH}
candidates.translation:
[Inifere asks question.]

{JOBY/MARK: 这其实更适合交给马克来处理（虽然乔比可以预先调整对话结构来更好地适应它），但我更希望看到玩家通过选择正确的话来推进对话，而不是解谜。（而且我不确定伊尼费尔的精神状态是否足以回答提问——他有点疯癫）。

所以大致是这样：
[Inifere is wary, but is listening.]
玩家回应：我知道你不想让那些教徒杀人。
[Inifere listens more.]
玩家回应：马尔西萨……你爱过她，对吧。
[Inifere nods, not trusting himself to say words.]
玩家回应：我可以帮你。我可以改变发生在马尔西萨身上的事。让我进入你的记忆示器。
[Inifere reluctantly agrees.]

当然，这些选项之外也得有其他无法取胜的选项（或者另辟蹊径的取胜选项也未尝不可——以玩家觉得最有趣的方式为准）。-AH}

candidates.source: You suddenly notice a black, tiny humanoid figure dancing around the curvature of the index fingers, down toward the palm and around the back of the glove, each footstep marked by an almost-imperceptible metal clang. The tiny man is clad in black leather armor - and he is not dancing, but defending himself against an invisible opponent. The sounds grow louder the longer you watch. He deftly maneuvers  with sword and buckler, growing ever-larger as you watch. Suddenly, he stops and faces you, and says, "Meeezhhaul kor veena.." He stares at you, imploring you to take on his eternal task. You look away with difficulty, and the man goes back to his fighting.

explanation_candidates.source: "Inifere created our order, splitting from the cursed Dendra O'Hur centuries ago. He has lived all this time, carrying the Gate with him, and we seek to honor his work by freeing the spirits of the living from their carnal prisons. Each sacrifice brings us closer to the Gate, closer to the truth, and so we must cut and bleed our way to epiphany."
explanation_candidates.translation: “伊尼费雷创立了我们的教团，数个世纪前从受诅咒的邓德拉·欧赫尔中分裂而出。他活过了这漫长岁月，随身携带着那道门，而我们要通过将生者的灵魂从肉体的牢笼中解放出来，来荣耀他的事业。每一次献祭都让我们更接近那道门，更接近真言，因此我们必须以刀锋和鲜血开辟通往顿悟之路。”，“负重”一词在原文“carrying the Gate with him”中为动词“携带”之义，并非名词“负重”，若强行使用“负重”会造成语义错误，故此处不采用该术语。
